name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  June 04 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Chambers,
9th Floor, on June 04, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, Deputy City Clerk Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Dionte Johnson on behalf of Kingsgrowe to host a Kingsgrow X World Cup Event at
300 S. Market St- Private Property from Friday, June 12, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.;
Saturday, June 13, 2026, through July 19, 2026, from 2:30 p.m. -6:00 p.m. Approval for a multi-
day event on Market Street. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way.
Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC
regulations. IPD approves; must provide security outside; approval of games based on avaiilablty;
event set-up will come out scheduled games; screen on wheels mobilized/ demobilized each day;
Applicant must have event flexibility; No tents, no drones, and no Fireworks; City of Inglewood can
make last-minute changes; Applicant must provide the number of parking spaces for Public Works
Department; screen/barriers must be visible; applicant must provide their event schedule for set-
up; Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00272523)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
